skill.name: developer-growth-analysis
skill.description: Analyzes recent Claude Code chat history to identify developer growth patterns, recommend focused improvements, find relevant HackerNews resources, and deliver a report to Slack.
skill.summary: Creates evidence-based developer growth reports from recent Claude Code chat history.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most Ruby backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code spans, not executable code. The filesystem findings are confirmed because the skill instructs reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl, which contains private chat history and pasted content. I also found a privacy risk where the generated report is sent to Slack without explicit redaction or confirmation steps.

remediation.suggestion: Request explicit consent before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl and document which fields are processed.

remediation.issue: Sends derived chat analysis to Slack
remediation.suggestion: Add a preview and confirmation step before Slack delivery, with clear options to skip external sending.

remediation.issue: No guidance for sensitive pasted content
remediation.suggestion: Redact secrets, credentials, private code, and personal data before analysis or external delivery.

content.value_statement: Developers often lack structured feedback from everyday coding sessions. This skill reviews recent Claude Code history and creates targeted growth recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Reads local Claude Code history from ~/.claude/history.jsonl for recent entries.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, and recurring challenges.
Generates prioritized improvement areas with evidence and action items.
Searches HackerNews through Rube MCP for related learning resources.
Sends formatted growth reports to the user's Slack DMs through Rube MCP.
limitations: Requires access to local Claude Code history and may expose sensitive chat content.
Resource quality depends on HackerNews search results and available Rube tools.
Slack delivery requires an authenticated Slack connection.
It does not inspect repository code unless it appears in chat history.

use_cases.title: Weekly Growth Review
use_cases.description: Review recent coding conversations and choose one focused skill area for the next week.

use_cases.title: Mentor Preparation
use_cases.description: Summarize recurring challenges before a coaching session or technical mentorship meeting.

use_cases.title: Learning Plan Creation
use_cases.description: Turn project-specific struggles into a short reading list and practical action items.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Growth Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a recent activity summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my developer growth from my recent Claude Code chats.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Time Window
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my work from today and identify three improvement areas with action items.

prompt_templates.title: Technology-Specific Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Connect feedback to one stack or domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my recent TypeScript and React chats, then recommend targeted learning resources.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Coaching Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a detailed report with evidence and prioritization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the past 48 hours of chats, rank my growth gaps, include evidence, and send the final report to my Slack DMs.

output_examples.input: Analyze my developer growth from my recent chats.
output_examples.output: A report summarizing recent work, three prioritized growth areas, observed strengths, action items, and HackerNews learning resources.

output_examples.input: Review my TypeScript work from today.
output_examples.output: A focused review of TypeScript patterns, repeated issues, recommended practice tasks, and links for deeper study.

output_examples.input: Send my weekly developer growth report to Slack.
output_examples.output: A Slack-ready report split into summary, improvements, strengths, next actions, and curated resources.

best_practices: Review the report before sharing it outside your local environment.
Run the analysis on a consistent weekly schedule for comparable results.
Focus on one recommended improvement area before starting another.
anti_patterns: Do not run it on chat history that includes secrets or private customer data.
Do not treat the recommendations as a replacement for expert code review.
Do not send reports to Slack before checking sensitive details.

faq.question: What data does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes recent Claude Code chat history from ~/.claude/history.jsonl.

faq.question: Does it read my repository files?
faq.answer: No. It only uses repository details that appear in your chat history.

faq.question: Can it send the report to Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Rube MCP to send a formatted report to your Slack DMs.

faq.question: Can it find learning resources?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches HackerNews for articles related to your improvement areas.

faq.question: Is the analysis private?
faq.answer: The skill reads local chat history, but Slack delivery moves report content to Slack.

faq.question: How often should I use it?
faq.answer: Weekly use is recommended because it gives enough activity for useful patterns.
